taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-03 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 193.6 | 0.90 | 0.90
2 | 129.1 | 3.18 | 4.08
3 | 29.1 | 0.79 | 4.87
4 | 29.8 | 26.64 | 31.51
5 | 165.4 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as QHA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-03
Curve type: QHA
Aquifer depth: 4.08 m – 31.51 m
Recommendation: Target the low-resistivity (29.1–29.8 Ω·m) zone between ~4 m and ~31.5 m depth as the primary water-bearing interval; set screen across this interval and case off the upper resistive layers, then terminate drilling once the high-resistivity basement (165.4 Ω·m) is encountered below 31.5 m to avoid unnecessary penetration into non-productive bedrock.
